newsitem.title: MALAWI: Sudan's Bashir arrives in Malawi from S.Africa.
newsitem.headline: Sudan's Bashir arrives in Malawi from S.Africa.

text.p: Sudanese President Omar Hassan al-Bashir arrived in Malawi on Wednesday for a two-day official visit.
He was welcomed at Blantyre Airport by Malawi's Vice President Justin Malewedzi. President Bakili Muluzi is currently on a four-day state visit to Swaziland.

Bashir left South Africa earlier in the day after meeting President Nelson Mandela on Tuesday. The Sudanese president called for a ceasefire in the gruelling 14-year civil war with rebels in the south of the country.
